title: Version 1.67.0
body:
Version 1.67.0 (🧸 The PLUSHIFICATION Update! 🧸)

September 21st, 2024

Added:

🧸 | Oaklands x Lootbloc

  • We are partnering with Lootbloc to bring you all sorts of merch to real life, including a limited time Grabbiest Grabber Plushie!
  • The plushie has 3 milestones, one at 50 sales, one at 100 sales, and one at 150 sales. Each milestone has different rewards, check it out on the store page!
  • Alongside all this plush, there is awesome desk mats, an embroidered shirt, and a hoodie! (The Oaklands catalog is here)
  • All of this can be found on Lootbloc's website. We need to reach at LEAST 50 sales for the plushie to be funded and made. It would mean the world if you took some time to check it out, or even just shared it!
  • Alongside all of this, there is an awesome IN GAME QUEST. The button at the top of the screen will tell you what to do and what you can get 😉

🔌 | No more annoying disconnects! Well... sort of!?

  • Getting disconnected will now save any items / vehicles near your player. You will also be returned to that location upon rejoin.
  • "This will not work if you are over an unclaimed property!

💎 | Magmite, Jade, Silver

  • Three new ores have been added! What a delight
  • Magmite slowly cools down before turning into obsidian, you can keep it heated by being in the deep caverns, or use some boxed lava!
  • Jade and Silver can be found in Sandslate, they're very pretty!

🪚 | The Bandsaw

  • You all have been YAPPING for this widely desired structure... we have delivered. The Bandsaw is a structure that automatically chops any wood below it!
  • It can be resized all you want, free liberty!
  • It's found at Dugg's Digging.

📈 | Stock Market

  • (most) Materials now are using a stock market! The stock market randomly changes the values of materials every day. This means that on some days, it might be better to farm other materials!
  • Boards are found at the Resource Hub showing their values.
  • Flowers are not yet supported!

👁️ | New Meteor!?

  • A new Meteor has been added, the Electrified Meteor. It's very spicy...

🦆 | Duck Shrine

  • I feel like I'm breaking into tiny shards of glass hearing about this STUPID DUCK SHRINE!!!

⛏️ | Ore Rework

  • The ore system has been entirely changed! You know how rocks could have a BUNCH of different ores all at once? Well that is no more! Rocks can only have one ore type at a time.
  • The entire ore RNG has also been redone.
  • Values of some ores and rocks have also been changed.

✋ | Throwing!

  • Ever wanted to throw items out of frustration? Now you can. (mobile not yet, sorry!)
  • Holding G (or Y/Triangle) will now launch items that you are dragging!

📖 | New Tutorial

  • We have created a new tutorial from the ground up. It is way more helpful, and should be more fun and intuitive for users!
  • This has helped us figure out the direction we want to take quests as well!

Changes:

😲 | So. Many. QoL. Changes.

  • I wish I could fit everything into one message, I really do, but there is SO MANY CHANGES. I CANNOT KEEP UP. Here's a few.
  • Night time is now brighter!
  • Items automatically anchor off the property!
  • Performance improvements!
  • Bombs always explode regardless of permissions!
  • If you read this message, there's a limited time code: OaklandsQoL, it gives you some non-tradeable cash!
  • Cheese & Marbles now display their color in their name!
  • New Code Redemption UI!
  • Flameslate is bigger!
  • Cool classic material walking sounds!

Version 1.67.1

September 21st, 2024

Changed:

  • Obsidian Belt resistance increase to 45 seconds, and regen timer reduced to 20 (+2.25) seconds

Version 1.67.3

September 22nd, 2024

Added:

  • Added more generalized color name prefix's to Cheese for color blind users to identify their color

Changed:

  • Reduced amount of rocks/trees that can spawn in magma cave and river cave. This should make it easier to drive!
  • Certain ores have been made rarer.
  • Decreased Flameslate hardness.
  • Made Magmite spawn more commonly.
  • Made Flameslate cheaper and Magmite more expensive.
  • ACTUALLY increased Obsidian Belt resistance to 45 seconds.

Fixes:

  • Fixed Classic Joop headlights.
  • Misc. Map fixes.

Version 1.67.4

September 22nd, 2024

Fixed:

  • Boomite instantly blowing up has been fixed (some servers might say 'now instantly blow up' because I wasn't paying attention as I wrote the changelog, but is fixed in some versions lol)

Version 1.67.45

September 22nd, 2024

Fixed:

  • Lootbloc plushie counter is now working again
